title: Semantic Audit Verdict
description: A structured, machine-readable verdict from the semantic audit layer (ARCHITECTURE.md §5). This layer is heuristic, not sound: it checks correspondence between a kernel-accepted statement and its stated intent, not a fact with an independent re-derivation procedure (ARCHITECTURE.md §7). failure_reason is null iff verdict == 'pass' (INTERFACES.md property 3: null never means a guess, it is the explicit encoding of 'no failure').

failure_reason.description: Nullable. Null iff verdict == 'pass'. A specific, machine-readable code — never free text — when verdict == 'fail'.

details.description: Structured evidence for the verdict (which check ran, what it found). Never a free-text narrative — a caller should be able to branch on its fields, not grep it.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this verdict was produced.
